manifest.name: Token Watch (beta)
manifest.plain: Shows the new tokens on a DEX pool that rose most since launch in the last hour, on the chains you pick (Avalanche to start), with what GoPlus or RugCheck report; Juli sums it up. It looks when you open it, and on its own only while it watches closely, while p0pc0rn is open. No advice.
manifest.description: The new tokens on a DEX pool that rose most since launch in the last hour on the chains you pick (Avalanche, Solana, Base, Ethereum, BNB Chain, Arbitrum): numbers from DEX Screener, flags as GoPlus and RugCheck report them. Read only, no advice. Fits: new tokens.
manifest.goal: Tell me which new tokens rose most since they launched, on the chains I pick
manifest.author: p0pc0rn

chains.desc: the chains it starts with, at most 3: avalanche, solana, base, ethereum, bsc (BNB Chain) or arbitrum; avalanche when the request names none

notes_for_juli: title: 1-3 words for what it watches (Token Watch, Launch Watch, New Tokens). chains: the chains the request names, from avalanche, solana, base, ethereum, bsc (BNB Chain) and arbitrum, at most 3; avalanche when it names none. Never put token names, addresses, prices or advice in slots: the app finds the tokens itself, ranks them in code and never gives advice. It says "rose most since launch", never "best", and shows only tokens on a DEX pool, never one still on a bonding curve. Example: "which new Solana and Base tokens rose most" -> title Token Watch, chains [solana, base].
